# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 1: Espionage, Court Intrigue, Dynastic Diplomacy 2.0 & 6 Universal Cabinet Actions (oe_dip2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v125_diplomacy.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. National Land & Tax Cadastre (全国税籍清丈)
oe_dip2_cab_national_cadastre = {
	ability = adm
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations > 0
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			scope:is_active ?= yes
			NOT = {
				any_cabinet = {
					has_cabinet_action = yes
					cabinet_action = cabinet_action:oe_van_v97_cab_cadastral_audit
				}
			}
		}
	}

	country_modifier = {
		tax_income_efficiency = 0.12
		global_monthly_control = 0.002
		global_crown_estate_power = 0.08
		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.05
		peasants_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.03
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 16 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { stability < 0 }
				subtract = { value = 20 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 2. Coinage Assay & Anti-Debasement Reform (反劣币铸币整顿)
# Cross-worker contract: sets/removes `oe_dip2_coinage_active_flag` for W4 Silver Price Revolution reform discounts.
oe_dip2_cab_coinage_anti_debasement = {
	ability = adm
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations > 0
		OR = {
			inflation >= 0.03
			current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		num_locations > 0
	}

	on_activate = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_coinage_active_flag value = 1 }
		}
	}

	on_deactivate = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_dip2_coinage_active_flag }
				remove_variable = oe_dip2_coinage_active_flag
			}
		}
	}

	country_modifier = {
		monthly_inflation = -0.0004
		minting_inflation_threshold = 0.05
		bank_interest = -0.005
		minting_income_factor = -0.15
		burghers_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.03
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = -10 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { inflation >= 0.04 }
				add = { value = 20 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { inflation >= 0.08 }
				add = { value = 25 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 4. Ever-Normal Granary Price Stabilization (常备粮仓平粜)
# Cross-worker contract: sets/removes `oe_dip2_granary_active_flag` for W4 Little Ice Age relief discounts.
oe_dip2_cab_ever_normal_granary = {
	ability = adm
	helps_with = "location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations > 0
	}

	allow = {
		num_locations > 0
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_dip2_cab_ever_normal_granary_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_dip2_cab_ever_normal_granary_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				controller ?= scope:actor
			}
			NOT = {
				cabinet_already_performing_same_task_on_target = {
					cabinet_action = oe_dip2_cab_ever_normal_granary
					interaction_target = target
				}
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	on_activate = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			set_variable = { name = oe_dip2_granary_active_flag value = 1 }
		}
	}

	on_deactivate = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_dip2_granary_active_flag }
				remove_variable = oe_dip2_granary_active_flag
			}
		}
	}

	country_modifier = {
		global_food_capacity_modifier = 0.15
		food_purchase_efficiency = 0.10
		tax_income_efficiency = -0.04
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_food_capacity_modifier = 0.30
		local_monthly_food_modifier = 0.15
		local_unrest = -0.04
	}

	map_marker = {
		show_for_owner = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 8 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { any_province = { is_starving = yes } }
				add = { value = 35 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 5. Naval Timber Reserves & Shipyard Quota (海防林场与造船配额)

	helps_with = "location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no

	}

	allow = {

	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_dip2_cab_naval_timber_quota_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_dip2_cab_naval_timber_quota_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				controller ?= scope:actor
				is_port = yes
			}
			NOT = {
				cabinet_already_performing_same_task_on_target = {
					cabinet_action = oe_dip2_cab_naval_timber_quota
					interaction_target = target
				}
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH

	country_modifier = {
		ship_build_speed = 0.15

	location_modifier = {

# 6. Frontier Post-Road & Relay Patrol (边疆驿站巡查)
oe_dip2_cab_frontier_post_patrol = {
	ability = dip
	helps_with = "location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations >= 3
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			scope:is_active ?= yes
			any_owned_location = {
				OR = {
					is_capital = no
					local_control < 0.85
				}
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_dip2_cab_frontier_post_patrol_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_dip2_cab_frontier_post_patrol_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				controller ?= scope:actor
				OR = {
					is_capital = no
					local_control < 0.85
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				cabinet_already_performing_same_task_on_target = {
					cabinet_action = oe_dip2_cab_frontier_post_patrol
					interaction_target = target
				}
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	country_modifier = {
		global_distance_from_capital_speed_propagation = 0.10
		global_road_building_time = -0.15
		stability_cost_efficiency = -0.04
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_monthly_control = 0.008
		local_max_control = 0.08
		local_supply_limit_modifier = 0.15
	}

	map_marker = {
		show_for_owner = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 6 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { num_locations >= 8 stability >= 0 }
				add = { value = 12 }
			}
		}
	}
}
